account.title: What an account gives you
account.savedAds: Ads you save, with a reminder before the closing date
account.matching: Ads matched against your profile, from Basic match to Top match

features.title: Everything you need to stay organised

search.body: All active job ads from Platsbanken, updated around the clock. Search by occupation and location, sort by recency or application deadline.

matching.body: Ads that match your profile get one of four grades, from Basic match up to Top match. Upload a CV and you also see which requirements you meet.

applications.body: Track every application from draft to response: interviews, offers and rejections. Nothing falls through the cracks.

cvReview.body: Get concrete feedback on what your CV should contain: what is missing, what is unclear and what can be highlighted.

companyWatch.body: Follow employers you want to work for and see their new ads on your overview. A smart watch finds companies by industry and municipality to follow.

reminders.body: You get a notice when saved ads approach their application deadline. Interviews, offers and unanswered applications also appear on your overview.

auth.free: Jobbliggaren is completely free to use.

footer.blurb: Keep your whole job search in order. Search, apply and follow up in one place.
footer.source: Built on open data from the Swedish Public Employment Service and Statistics Sweden
